mch_kapow_general_description:
You have been discovered in enemy territory!

We've sent reinforcements but they will take some time to reach your location

You will need to survive with the Captain's help for a while before reinforcements arrive.

Don't hesitate on using your weapon if you find yourself in danger!
mch_kapow_bullets_description: You'll have to dodge the Enemies's bullets by (PRESSING) the next notes:
mch_kapow_weapon_description:
You possess a semi-automatic rifle with 10 bullets.

Press (SPACE) to use your weapon.

If your weapon has bullets it will shoot at the closest enemy. Otherwise, it will try to recharge.

To recharge, you must do it to the rhythm of the song for 3 beats.

Practice a little. Press (SPACE).
mch_zombie_notes_description:
You'll have to (DODGE) Lumpy's hand no matter what.

If you press it, it will get stuck on your note and you won't be able to press that part's notes until the hand leaves.

Press the note over and over to take off the hand.
mch_zombie_fliqpy_description:
Fliqpy will hide onto the gravestones.

In order to dodge him, you'll have to blow where he might appear.
BUT BE CAREFUL!

You only have to blow if a (RED) sign appears in the gravestone.

If you fail, you will lose life and the mist will increase.
mch_title_subtitle: These notes will always appear in Trauma Difficulty!
